title: OFSCP GET /api/discover response (v0.1)
description: An optional, provider-compiled discovery feed (§11.2) drawn from discoverable-tier channels on known providers (§8.6). Items are pointers (recommendations), not authoritative copies — clients read the real content from each channel's home provider. How the feed is compiled and ranked is provider-defined.

channel.description: Reference (URI) to a discoverable channel being recommended.

provider.description: Domain of the channel's home provider.

sample.description: Optional cached preview of a recent message (non-authoritative); clients read the live message from the source.
